summary: Iteration 19: Frontend testing of game mechanics changes - obstacles now spawn at horizon and move DOWN toward player, character has animation effects (bob/stretch/squash), skin store displays unique images per skin type. All 12 features tested and verified working correctly.
passed_tests: Game loads with start screen showing Bullpug character and START button
Obstacles spawn at horizon (top/far) and move DOWN toward player - VERIFIED via multiple screenshots showing meteors starting small at top and growing larger
Character renders with Bullpug sprite image
Character has running bob animation when not jumping
Character has jump animation with stretch/squash effects
Mooncakes spawn at horizon and move down the track - VERIFIED with yellow collectible visible at different depths
Collision detection works when obstacles reach player depth - Game Over triggered when meteor hits player
Skin store displays 12 unique character images for each skin type
Fire skin (Inferno) shows fire.jpg image with flame styling
Water skin (Aqua) shows water.jpg image with aquatic styling
Zombie skin shows zombie.jpg image with undead styling
Diamond skin shows diamond.jpg image with crystal styling
Gold skin shows gold.jpg image with golden styling
Lane switching works with A/D keys - player moves between 3 lanes smoothly
3D perspective rendering with converging lanes visible
Jump mechanics work with Space key
Score increases during gameplay
Game Over screen shows correctly with score, stage reached, mooncakes collected
RETRY button works to restart game
SHARE X button visible for Twitter sharing
Leaderboard integration works - 'Rank #3 this week!' notification shown
seed_data_creation: Scores submitted to leaderboard during gameplay tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified: 1) Obstacles now use depth-based movement system where depth=0 is horizon and depth=1 is player level. Meteors spawn at horizon (small/far) and grow larger as they approach player (moving DOWN the track). 2) Character has animation effects - bob motion when running, stretch/squash when jumping. 3) Skin store displays 12 unique character images from the library (fire.jpg->Inferno, water.jpg->Aqua, zombie.jpg, etc.). Lane switching with A/D keys, jumping with Space, collision detection, and game over flow all working correctly.

obstacle_movement.direction: FROM horizon (top/far) TO player (bottom/near) - obstacles move DOWN the track
obstacle_movement.depth_system: depth=0 at horizon, depth=1 at player level, obstacles grow larger as they approach
obstacle_movement.verified: Multiple screenshots show meteors starting small at top and increasing in size as they approach player

character_animation.running_bob: Character has vertical bob motion when running (not jumping)
character_animation.jump_stretch: Character stretches vertically when jumping upward
character_animation.jump_squash: Character squashes when landing from jump

skin_store_images.unique_images: Each skin type has unique character image from library
skin_store_images.all_12_skins: Guardian, Ethereal, Diamond, Gold, Silver, Heatmap, Radioactive, Zombie, Aqua, Inferno, Cyber, Phantom

game_mechanics.jump: Space key triggers jump with physics
game_mechanics.collision: Obstacles hitting player triggers game over
game_mechanics.mooncake_collection: Collectibles can be gathered for points
